en.name: Clasped-hands overhead stretch
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with your feet apart and shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands together and gently interlace your fingers if comfortable.
Reach your joined hands above your head, turning the palms upwards only as comfortable. Keep both feet down.
Lower your hands and relax. Follow your teacher’s pace without forcing the reach.
en.focus: Teacher marks a reach and release; finger position and stretch intensity are observed manually.

zh-Hant.name: 十指交扣向上伸展
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙腳分開站立，肩膀放鬆。
雙手合起，舒適時可輕輕十指交扣。
雙手向頭頂上方伸展，掌心按舒適程度轉向上，雙腳留在地上。
放下雙手並放鬆，跟著老師的速度，不要勉強伸高。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次伸展及放鬆記作一次，手指位置及伸展幅度由老師觀察。
